Solution provided: Implementation of ServiceNow HRSD for process automation, self-service portal, compliance enhancement, and data-driven decision-making.

Results/Benefits achieved.Regulatory adherence: Strengthened with secure document management and standardized approval processes
Results/Benefits achieved.Leadership insights: Real-time insights through advanced reporting and workforce planning dashboards

full_content:
Process Automation
Reduced HR case resolution time by 50% through intelligent workflows and digital service delivery.
Self-Service Portal
Empowered employees with a centralized platform, increasing self-service adoption by 40%.
Compliance Enhancement
Strengthened regulatory adherence with secure document management and standardized approval processes.
Data-Driven Decisions
Equipped leadership with real-time insights through advanced reporting and workforce planning dashboards.
